issue.title: Add SmallRye Reactive Streams Operators dependency to Vert.x

body:
Reopening as we had to revert it in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/3896 .

The current fix causes issues as we need the `-deployment` dependency to be in the deployment artifact and the `-runtime` dependency to be in the runtime artifact.

The proposed fix mistakenly add the runtime dependency to the deployment artifact.

That being said, I tried to do it properly and we have a circular dependency due to some test dependencies creating a circular dependency. We will probably need to move these tests to some IT.
